title: Child musicians on the corners and Greene following the bands
summary: The boys played from about seven to fifteen across the whole city, and hearing the brass is what drew Greene to music.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Getting my first drums, with or without lessons

blocks.x: How old would they be when they were out on the corners? Eight-seventeen? No? Not that old?
No, no, no. Not that old. Maybe, I'd say from maybe seven to about fourteen or fifteen.
You mean that kids seven and eight would be out blowing their horns?

Heck, yeah. Yeah, they trained, you know, real young. And they were on the corner playing -- seven, you know -- say about from seven on up to about -- I'd say about fourteen or fifteen years old, or sixteen.
Would they play in white parts of town?
All over. Anywhere. Well, you see, Charleston was a city that -- there's no "across the track".
Oh, there isn't? Everything is everywhere.
You know, there's whites here, blacks here.
Everything is everywhere?
So there was no -- I mean there was no separation, not really.
No? No. Which is good, isn't it Freddie? It's better --
No, no. It was okay.
Yeah.
There's a few little things way back.
Yeah.
As far as the music end of it is concerned, Jenkin's was all over the city. You know, they would play -- and I would just follow them all over. Wherever they'd go. I think
that had alot to do with it. The minute I heard that brass, I --
(laugh) Any of the other kids you played with like you?
Oh yeah, you know, you know, how kids are, we'd get together and follow all over the place.
Yeah.
Well, this is one thing where poor kids like that could get some musical training.
Right. Right.
I mean, you wouldn't get that at school would you?
No, no, no.
No.
Not during that period you didn't have anything like -- like, you know, bands in schools.
So they had quite alot of instruments if they could put five bands out.
Oh, yeah.
Well, then they sent the bands out through the country?

Oh, yeah. All over the world. Jenkins' band has been everywhere. They've played before the King and Queen. They had big -- you know -- it was a big thing. They had -- 9 And they used to go all over the country.
Fancy that.
Yeah.
